This analysis is descriptive of the provided differential results and cannot infer causality or raw sample-level variance.

grader_notes: The agent correctly loaded the data and applied 5% FDR filtering, but then abandoned the assay dimension, computing global tissue z-score vectors and cosine similarities instead of per-assay feature sets and Jaccard similarities. criterion_1.reason: Identified assay and tissue fields, iterated over all 9 omes, but did not report per-assay × per-tissue feature counts as required for A.

criterion_2.reason: Used training_q < 0.05 consistently across all assays after median aggregation, matching the 5% FDR criterion.

criterion_3.reason: Collapsed features across assays instead of de-duplicating within each (tissue, assay) cell; effectively ignored the assay dimension.

criterion_4.reason: Computed tissue-level cosine similarity of z-scores, not per-assay set-similarity metrics like Jaccard or overlap coefficient; no per-assay similarity matrices.

criterion_5.reason: Aggregated across assays without accounting for tissue × assay coverage gaps, implicitly assuming full coverage.

criterion_6.reason: No cross-assay aggregation of per-assay similarities was performed; instead aggregated raw z-scores across assays, discarding the required two-stage approach.

criterion_7.reason: Listed top coordinated tissue pairs with some biological interpretation, but the interpretation is generic and lacks explicit source attribution to specific MoTrPAC or exercise-physiology references.
